reason: Reviewed all five surfaces for reopening a Claude Code conversation T3 Code stopped. Lifecycle hooks: definitions and output unchanged; the SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and Stop handlers that already keep reopen_launch now also keep the T3 Code thread T3 Code names in the hook's own environment (T3CODE_THREAD_ID, T3CODE_CLI_PATH when its basename is t3, T3CODE_HOME when absolute), in local session state only; nothing new is sent. The hub, for a stopped claude-code session whose place is t3, runs that t3 with `thread send <thread> -` and the existing token-less Notifai wake text, only while the T3 Code server named by <T3 home>/userdata/server-runtime.json runs, never for a Codex thread, within the existing two-attempt and burst limits, retrying a busy T3 database twice; the conversation coming back confirms it. Notifai skill: references/harness-claude-code.md now says a conversation T3 Code stopped continues in its own thread while T3 Code runs and names reopen.t3; references/diagnostics.md names the T3 Code thread in the Reopen row. Harness setup: unchanged. CLI readiness: new machine-only setting reopen.t3 (when-running default, off), and doctor's Reopen line adds 'T3 Code threads while T3 Code runs'; ask readiness unchanged. Domain terms: unchanged. skills/guidance-changes.json carries one new release note for this change.
